scope: Targeted review of downloaded full texts: author/affiliation front matter and specified body, results, discussion or technical sections. Page references identify consulted PDF pages, including selected passages; this is not a claim of exhaustive line-by-line reading or independent reproduction. Downloads alone never establish review completion.

f04.method: Intrinsic reward compares old and improved compressors on the same accumulated data; the controller seeks expected future compression progress. The appendix separates compression length, runtime cost and delayed compressor-improvement feedback.
f04.evidence: This is a conceptual and algorithmic account with connections to earlier implementations, rather than a controlled modern scientific-agent benchmark.
f04.discovery_use: A candidate discovery objective is improvement in an agent-relative explanatory code, not novelty or prediction error alone.
f04.limits: Compressor choice and computational restrictions determine what is discoverable. The strongest optimal action-selection reference is incomputable; asynchronous improvement also creates a credit-assignment problem.

classification_review.rationale: Intrinsic reward compares old and improved compressors on the same accumulated data; the controller seeks expected future compression progress. f05.method: Contrasts two-part description length with refined universal coding and normalized maximum likelihood, exposing model-complexity costs that depend on a specified model family.
f05.evidence: Tutorial derivations and worked statistical examples support the criterion; this is not an experimental agent-training study.
f05.discovery_use: Provides an explicit fit-versus-complexity objective for candidate explanations, and a way to discuss changes in an effective hypothesis language.
f05.limits: Ideal Kolmogorov complexity is uncomputable. Practical model partitioning, finite-sample coding choices and optimization approximations affect conclusions; compression does not by itself establish causation.

classification_review.rationale: Contrasts two-part description length with refined universal coding and normalized maximum likelihood, exposing model-complexity costs that depend on a specified model family. Its main contribution supplies definitions, theory, or a synthesis of discovery research.

f01.evidence: Location finding, temporal discounting and a death-process model compare information bounds and deployment cost; the paper also contrasts nonmyopic and myopic designs.
f01.discovery_use: A direct precedent for learning experiment selection rather than merely solving a fixed question, with train-time amortization and test-time evidence gathering separated.
f01.limits: The prior, likelihood and latent parameter family are supplied. Informative parameter estimation within that family is narrower than discovering an unanticipated mechanism or representation.

classification_review.rationale: Optimizes a design policy over entire experimental histories using sequential contrastive lower bounds on information gain. f03.discovery_use: An implementation baseline for training evidence-seeking behavior from belief updates rather than raw environmental surprise.
f03.limits: Variational approximation and model misspecification affect the bonus. Better control return is not direct evidence of scientific mechanism recovery.

classification_review.rationale: Adds an approximate KL change in a Bayesian dynamics model to the external reward, using variational neural-network inference and a practical second-order approximation. h01.method: A meta-agent writes and refines executable agent designs, storing prior candidates and their evaluations to guide later proposals.
h01.evidence: The body separates representation, search algorithm and evaluation, and reports search and test splits plus transfer of selected designs.
h01.discovery_use: Treats workflows, prompts and tool orchestration as searchable representations instead of assuming the harness is fixed.
h01.limits: A Turing-complete language does not imply feasible coverage of all agents. Validation-set search, tool costs and transfer conditions constrain the result.

classification_review.rationale: A meta-agent writes and refines executable agent designs, storing prior candidates and their evaluations to guide later proposals. Its main contribution generates new challenges or modifies agent designs and improvement procedures.

h02.method: Trains agents within their actual runtime harness, explicitly handling prompt reconstruction, token-prefix compatibility, variable sample counts and rollout-level normalization.
h02.evidence: Worked examples show identical text with different token boundaries and how different loss aggregation choices reweight rollouts.
h02.discovery_use: A direct checklist for converting long scientific-agent traces into correctly aligned training samples.
h02.limits: Text matching alone is insufficient for merging sampled tokens. These infrastructure fixes do not determine what a scientifically valid reward should be.

classification_review.rationale: Trains agents within their actual runtime harness, explicitly handling prompt reconstruction, token-prefix compatibility, variable sample counts and rollout-level normalization. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

h03.method: Externalizes candidate pools, document memory, evidence graphs and curation state while training the policy to make semantic search and selection decisions.
h03.evidence: Retrieval benchmarks separate final curated recall from trajectory recall, and same-checkpoint ablations disable individual state-management components.
h03.discovery_use: A concrete division between reliable harness bookkeeping and trainable evidence-seeking decisions.
h03.limits: Retrieval relevance and recall do not verify a new scientific claim. Harness ablations at inference measure dependence on the trained interface, not an isolated universal contribution to capability.

classification_review.rationale: Externalizes candidate pools, document memory, evidence graphs and curation state while training the policy to make semantic search and selection decisions. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

h04.method: Rotates a small active set of harness variants according to mastery and learnability rather than training on a fixed prompt or uniformly large prompt pool.
h04.evidence: Search experiments distinguish parallel-search behavior from answer success and include cue-free harnesses and an out-of-distribution shopping setting.
h04.discovery_use: Suggests evaluating discovery skills across paraphrased and structurally varied harnesses instead of measuring them only under the training interface.
h04.limits: Parallelization is one behavior in one search family. Harness robustness is not equivalent to new scientific domains, and curriculum thresholds are design choices.

classification_review.rationale: Rotates a small active set of harness variants according to mastery and learnability rather than training on a fixed prompt or uniformly large prompt pool. Its main contribution concerns training objectives, policy learning, meta-learning, or the data and feedback used to form capabilities.

h05.method: Organizes harness candidates and matched outcome records as explicit interventions, producing both deployable designs and provenance-linked training examples for later model updates.
h05.evidence: The inspected formalization separates fixed-harness utility, portfolio coverage and oracle routing ceilings; a code-repair case study motivates the interface.
h05.discovery_use: A useful data schema for jointly studying harness variation and the model-training data those variations generate.
h05.limits: Oracle portfolio yield is not deployable performance without a router. The conceptual co-evolution loop and verified data yield should not be mistaken for evidence of indefinite repeated model-harness improvement.

classification_review.rationale: Organizes harness candidates and matched outcome records as explicit interventions, producing both deployable designs and provenance-linked training examples for later model updates. Its main contribution generates new challenges or modifies agent designs and improvement procedures.

d08.method: Combines idea generation, progressive experiment-tree search, analysis and manuscript generation, with experiment management and visual feedback.
d08.evidence: The body describes separate investigation, tuning, agenda and ablation stages, and evaluates generated manuscripts through a workshop-review setting.
d08.discovery_use: A system baseline for the complete research workflow and for collecting traces of experimental branching and reporting.
d08.limits: Peer-review acceptance and scientific validity are different measurements. The harness coordinates experiments, but this does not establish that the underlying model was trained to acquire a transferable discovery skill.

classification_review.rationale: Combines idea generation, progressive experiment-tree search, analysis and manuscript generation, with experiment management and visual feedback. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

d09.method: Uses a multi-agent hypothesis-generation, critique and refinement system with scientist-provided objectives and feedback.
d09.evidence: The consulted body distinguishes internally ranked hypothesis quality, expert comparisons and separate biomedical validation projects.
d09.discovery_use: A reference for hypothesis-search orchestration and the separation between proposal ranking and external experimental evidence.
d09.limits: An internal Elo increase is not itself a biological validation. Expert participation, selected validation cases and the frozen-model inference budget must remain visible.

classification_review.rationale: Uses a multi-agent hypothesis-generation, critique and refinement system with scientist-provided objectives and feedback. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

coscientist.method: Connects an LLM planner to web/documentation search, code execution and laboratory automation, including chemistry and hardware-specific interfaces.
coscientist.evidence: The body includes physical liquid-handling and reaction demonstrations, while some optimization comparisons query previously measured datasets; these are distinct evidence modes.
coscientist.discovery_use: Shows why physical execution, documentation grounding and validation interfaces belong in a scientific-agent harness.
coscientist.limits: The system is described as semi-autonomous and relies on selected equipment and human setup. Recorded-data optimization should not be labeled new wet-lab experimentation.

classification_review.rationale: Connects an LLM planner to web/documentation search, code execution and laboratory automation, including chemistry and hardware-specific interfaces. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

survey-autonomy.method: Classifies LLM roles as tools, analysts and scientists across stages of the scientific method, pairing methods with benchmark and domain examples.
survey-autonomy.evidence: The inspected taxonomy covers hypothesis generation, experiment execution, analysis and refinement with references to original systems.
survey-autonomy.discovery_use: A navigation framework for the awesome list and for separating individual research-stage competence from end-to-end autonomy.
survey-autonomy.limits: A survey label is not an empirical capability score. Each cited system still requires its own audit of training, evidence access and scientific validation.

classification_review.rationale: Classifies LLM roles as tools, analysts and scientists across stages of the scientific method, pairing methods with benchmark and domain examples. Its main contribution supplies definitions, theory, or a synthesis of discovery research.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
survey-agentic-science.method: Combines workflow stages, autonomy levels and architectural mechanisms into a domain-oriented organization of agentic science.
survey-agentic-science.evidence: The consulted framework distinguishes computational tools, partial research assistants and autonomous-partner aspirations, with discipline-specific examples.
survey-agentic-science.discovery_use: Helps choose coverage categories and identify gaps between a workflow claim and the components actually evaluated.
survey-agentic-science.limits: The autonomy categories synthesize literature rather than establish a common quantitative benchmark. The review consulted the framework sections, not every domain citation in the long survey.

classification_review.rationale: Combines workflow stages, autonomy levels and architectural mechanisms into a domain-oriented organization of agentic science. Its main contribution supplies definitions, theory, or a synthesis of discovery research.

d01.method: Provides interactive simulated investigations with instrument use, interventions, hypothesis formation and explanatory outputs.
d01.evidence: Scorecards distinguish task completion, procedural actions and explanatory knowledge. Separate unit tasks help diagnose navigation and tool-use failures that would otherwise confound discovery scores.
d01.discovery_use: A training/evaluation substrate for complete long-horizon investigations with separate process and knowledge measurements.
d01.limits: Designed scenarios and rules bound the possible discoveries. Action competence and causal understanding can fail independently, and explanatory grading requires an evaluator audit.

classification_review.rationale: Provides interactive simulated investigations with instrument use, interventions, hypothesis formation and explanatory outputs. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

d02.method: Lets a scientist agent query a hidden probabilistic world, revise a model and communicate an explanation to a novice whose predictions evaluate that explanation.
d02.evidence: The body separates information-gain/regret measures, predictive error and communication-based model discovery across generative domains.
d02.discovery_use: A useful decomposition of evidence acquisition, model quality and reusable communication, rather than scoring only a final answer.
d02.limits: Information gain is defined relative to the supplied generative model and parameterization. Communication scores also depend on the receiving agent; these are simulated rather than prospective human or laboratory measurements.

classification_review.rationale: Lets a scientist agent query a hidden probabilistic world, revise a model and communicate an explanation to a novice whose predictions evaluate that explanation. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

d03.method: Mutates canonical physical-law expressions and embeds them in increasingly complex interactive model systems to test identification beyond familiar formulas.
d03.evidence: Evaluations separate symbolic accuracy, predictive fidelity and token cost; the noise analysis shows that these metrics can diverge.
d03.discovery_use: A control against memorization and a way to evaluate active experimental design under known hidden equations.
d03.limits: Equation mutations and simulator construction define the hypothesis family. Counterfactual physics is intentionally virtual, and numerical fit is not equivalent to correct symbolic recovery.

classification_review.rationale: Mutates canonical physical-law expressions and embeds them in increasingly complex interactive model systems to test identification beyond familiar formulas. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

d04.method: Constructs discovery questions and reference hypotheses from published data-analysis workflows, with a separate synthetic dataset-generation route.
d04.evidence: The body defines contexts, variables and relationships, and evaluates their recovery rather than treating every plausible explanation as correct.
d04.discovery_use: A fixed-data benchmark for hypothesis formulation, dataset interpretation and multistep analysis.
d04.limits: Published-reference matching narrows what counts as discovery, and reference-guided oracle feedback is a special condition. Existing scientific data do not constitute new physical experiment execution.

classification_review.rationale: Constructs discovery questions and reference hypotheses from published data-analysis workflows, with a separate synthetic dataset-generation route. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

c10.method: Manually specified SCMs generate ARC-like observational, interventional and counterfactual demonstrations, enabling several reasoning and adaptation protocols.
c10.evidence: The body separates static few-shot TTT, counterfactual prediction, program synthesis and logical causal-discovery evaluations.
c10.discovery_use: A controlled comparison of reasoning with different causal evidence types and a task-family generalization test.
c10.limits: Receiving intervention demonstrations differs from actively choosing interventions. Random instances do not by themselves guarantee a novel mechanism family or elimination of structural prior knowledge.

classification_review.rationale: Manually specified SCMs generate ARC-like observational, interventional and counterfactual demonstrations, enabling several reasoning and adaptation protocols. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

c11.method: Samples hidden SCMs, permits bounded interventions and asks agents for both held-out predictions and an explicit graph/mechanism description.
c11.evidence: Comparisons distinguish task accuracy from edge and mechanism fidelity, including cases where topology is preserved but changed functional forms break prediction.
c11.discovery_use: A close benchmark for measuring whether successful answers are backed by recovered mechanisms and appropriate experiments.
c11.limits: The variables, mechanisms and intervention interface are generated within a known family. High prediction accuracy is insufficient evidence of mechanism recovery; real-world causal sufficiency remains outside the simulator.

classification_review.rationale: Samples hidden SCMs, permits bounded interventions and asks agents for both held-out predictions and an explicit graph/mechanism description. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

c12.method: Uses computer-controlled physical chambers with actuators and sensors to generate heterogeneous datasets and interventions over well-characterized systems.
c12.evidence: Case studies evaluate causal discovery, shifts, time series and symbolic models against explicit physical structure, rather than assuming simulated ground truth represents real sensors perfectly.
c12.discovery_use: A bridge between inexpensive synthetic discovery and controlled physical experimentation with known mechanisms.
c12.limits: Recorded datasets, mechanistic simulators and remote live devices are separate usage modes. Access and experimental reset conditions must be checked for each live campaign; known physics does not make every measurement edge unambiguous.

classification_review.rationale: Uses computer-controlled physical chambers with actuators and sensors to generate heterogeneous datasets and interventions over well-characterized systems. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

scienceworld.method: Simulates elementary science tasks through interacting objects, simplified physical processes and executable textual actions.
scienceworld.evidence: The body compares online action agents and offline demonstration-based learners, and discusses the confound between scientific inference and everyday navigation competence.
scienceworld.discovery_use: A tool-use and experimental-execution baseline before testing novel mechanism discovery.
scienceworld.limits: Many target facts are familiar elementary science. Completing a designed procedure is not automatically the discovery of an unknown law, and simplified simulations constrain transfer.

classification_review.rationale: Simulates elementary science tasks through interacting objects, simplified physical processes and executable textual actions. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

scienceagentbench.method: Builds research-grounded programming tasks with heterogeneous datasets, expert-provided task knowledge and execution-based validation.
scienceagentbench.evidence: The inspected collection protocol removes exploitable target outputs and modifies selected datasets; comparisons separate success, executability, cost and optional expert knowledge.
scienceagentbench.discovery_use: A benchmark for reliable implementation of individual scientific workflow steps before making end-to-end autonomy claims.
scienceagentbench.limits: Executing a correct analysis over existing data does not run a new physical experiment or necessarily produce a novel scientific finding. Public artifacts create contamination risks that a benchmark protocol must track.

classification_review.rationale: Builds research-grounded programming tasks with heterogeneous datasets, expert-provided task knowledge and execution-based validation. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

genedisco.method: Evaluates batch acquisition policies and counterfactual outcome estimators over curated genetic-intervention screens.
genedisco.evidence: The body specifies a finite collection of measured outcomes, treatment embeddings and alternative acquisition functions, with predictive error as a benchmark objective.
genedisco.discovery_use: A reproducible finite-pool baseline for sample-efficient experiment selection using biological measurements.
genedisco.limits: The benchmark reveals already recorded outcomes. Improving predictive MSE or selecting hits is narrower than recovering a mechanistic causal explanation or executing new wet-lab experiments.

classification_review.rationale: Evaluates batch acquisition policies and counterfactual outcome estimators over curated genetic-intervention screens. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

biodiscoveryagent.method: Uses an LLM agent to select genetic perturbations in batches, incorporating prior observations and optional literature, critic and gene-search tools.
biodiscoveryagent.evidence: The body compares single-gene and gene-pair selection with ML baselines, and shows that extra tools help some underlying models while degrading others.
biodiscoveryagent.discovery_use: A concrete scientific evidence-acquisition workflow and a useful test of whether a harness component actually benefits a given policy.
biodiscoveryagent.limits: Historical-screen evaluation differs from a prospective experiment. Hit-rate gains and biological prior knowledge do not alone establish new causal mechanism discovery; effects of essential genes and prior exposure require controls.

classification_review.rationale: Uses an LLM agent to select genetic perturbations in batches, incorporating prior observations and optional literature, critic and gene-search tools. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

a02.method: Evolves executable candidate programs with an LLM ensemble, a program database and task-specific automated evaluators, using successful candidates and feedback in later prompts.
a02.evidence: The inspected white-paper body distinguishes the scientist-supplied initial program and evaluator from the search system, and explains candidate filtering and population reuse.
a02.discovery_use: A strong frozen-model search baseline when evaluating the benefit of weight updates in discovery.
a02.limits: The automatically evaluable objective and program representation are supplied. Improving infrastructure used for AI training is not the same as the LLM updating its own weights during search.

classification_review.rationale: Evolves executable candidate programs with an LLM ensemble, a program database and task-specific automated evaluators, using successful candidates and feedback in later prompts. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

as-bench.method: Runs budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns, judging both the quality of measured designs and prediction/ranking of held-out designs.
as-bench.evidence: The paper specifies five recorded-data replay campaigns and one digital-twin campaign, with a live physical backend described as planned. Gate calibration and failure decompositions distinguish acquisition success from predictive learning.
as-bench.discovery_use: A directly relevant benchmark for the separability of finding promising experiments and learning a reusable model under a limited measurement budget.
as-bench.limits: The initial campaigns use predefined design spaces and existing measurements or a surrogate. A lab-service API alone is not evidence of new physical execution; calibrated gate choices also shape the measured capability.

classification_review.rationale: Runs budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns, judging both the quality of measured designs and prediction/ranking of held-out designs. Its main contribution defines or audits the tasks, evidence, criteria, or measurements used to assess discovery.

University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
survey-scientific-intelligence.method: Organizes scientific agents around planners, memory, action spaces and verifiers, distinguishing prompt-native planning from learned planning.
survey-scientific-intelligence.evidence: Inspected the architectural taxonomy and examples of reflective, tool-using and learned planners in the revised survey.
survey-scientific-intelligence.discovery_use: A mechanism-level index for separating harness design, policy learning and evidence verification in a discovery agent.
survey-scientific-intelligence.limits: A narrative survey does not establish that one architecture causes better discovery; its benchmark coverage must be checked against original papers.

classification_review.rationale: Organizes scientific agents around planners, memory, action spaces and verifiers, distinguishing prompt-native planning from learned planning. Its main contribution supplies definitions, theory, or a synthesis of discovery research.

survey-agentic-ai.method: Reviews single- and multi-agent scientific workflows, implementations, datasets and task-dependent evaluation metrics.
survey-agentic-ai.evidence: Inspected the application taxonomy, experimental-assistance examples and discussion of paper-quality versus task-success metrics.
survey-agentic-ai.discovery_use: Provides entry points into domain-specific systems and reliability questions across the research lifecycle.
survey-agentic-ai.limits: Its broad agency definition includes literature and workflow assistance; those activities alone do not demonstrate new scientific knowledge. The PDF claims ICLR 2025; the precise conference/workshop track requires separate verification.

classification_review.rationale: Reviews single- and multi-agent scientific workflows, implementations, datasets and task-dependent evaluation metrics. Its main contribution supplies definitions, theory, or a synthesis of discovery research.

alphatensor.method: An AlphaZero-style policy/value network guides tensor-decomposition search; training combines played games, synthetic factorization demonstrations and problem symmetries.
alphatensor.evidence: Inspected the exact zero-residual correctness condition, search/policy-improvement mechanics, algorithm ranks and hardware-tailored evaluation.
alphatensor.discovery_use: A direct discovery-RL precedent showing how to obtain valid synthetic training instances when generating solutions is easier than solving the forward problem.
alphatensor.limits: The factor alphabet, tensor representation and objective are designed in advance. Finite-field rank improvements must not be conflated with real-arithmetic or universal asymptotic improvements.

classification_review.rationale: An AlphaZero-style policy/value network guides tensor-decomposition search; training combines played games, synthetic factorization demonstrations and problem symmetries. Its main contribution specifies how candidate explanations or artifacts are proposed, searched, tested, or selected.

funsearch.method: A frozen LLM proposes programs while an evaluator and island-based program database retain useful candidates and construct subsequent prompts.
funsearch.evidence: Inspected the program/skeleton representation, valid-candidate feedback loop and mathematical versus bin-packing results.
funsearch.discovery_use: A necessary search-only baseline: externally verified discoveries can occur without any test-time parameter training.
funsearch.limits: The evaluator, skeleton and program language determine the searchable boundary. Large sampling budgets and task-specific verifiers make comparisons with trained policies budget-sensitive.

classification_review.rationale: A frozen LLM proposes programs while an evaluator and island-based program database retain useful candidates and construct subsequent prompts. Its main contribution specifies how candidate explanations or artifacts are proposed, searched, tested, or selected.

llm-sr.method: A frozen LLM proposes executable equation skeletons; numerical optimization fits constants, and scored programs are retained in a clustered experience buffer for iterative refinement.
llm-sr.evidence: Inspected the fitness definition, program sampling rules, in/out-of-domain error comparisons and ablations removing scientific priors and program representations.
llm-sr.discovery_use: A useful frozen-policy baseline against which to measure whether RL actually improves equation search efficiency or generalization.
llm-sr.limits: Descriptions supply substantial scientific priors; low prediction error does not establish a unique mechanism or causal identifiability. The evaluator and available operators delimit discovery.

classification_review.rationale: A frozen LLM proposes executable equation skeletons; numerical optimization fits constants, and scored programs are retained in a clustered experience buffer for iterative refinement. Its main contribution specifies how candidate explanations or artifacts are proposed, searched, tested, or selected.

pysr.method: Asynchronous expression populations combine mutation, crossover, age regularization, migration, simplification and continuous constant optimization under accuracy/complexity tradeoffs.
pysr.evidence: Inspected the inner/outer-loop pseudocode, adaptive complexity penalties and support for user-defined operators and losses.
pysr.discovery_use: A strong non-LLM search baseline and a concrete example of how a representation grammar and an optimizer jointly determine what can be discovered.
pysr.limits: Fits empirical relations within user-specified operators and constraints; successful fitting is not evidence of causal truth. Performance depends on search and computation budgets.

classification_review.rationale: Asynchronous expression populations combine mutation, crossover, age regularization, migration, simplification and continuous constant optimization under accuracy/complexity tradeoffs. Its main contribution specifies how candidate explanations or artifacts are proposed, searched, tested, or selected.

deep-symbolic-regression.method: An autoregressive recurrent policy emits expression trees and is optimized using the conditional reward of samples above a reward quantile.
deep-symbolic-regression.evidence: Inspected the risk-seeking objective/gradient and expression-recovery comparisons on Nguyen tasks, including cases with incomplete recovery.
deep-symbolic-regression.discovery_use: Direct precedent for optimizing the best discovered result rather than average rollout reward; important when comparing discovery RL with ordinary task-solving RL.
deep-symbolic-regression.limits: The token library, expression constraints and synthetic task family restrict the hypothesis space; tail-focused training can lose diversity and does not replace independent validation.

classification_review.rationale: An autoregressive recurrent policy emits expression trees and is optimized using the conditional reward of samples above a reward quantile. Its main contribution specifies how candidate explanations or artifacts are proposed, searched, tested, or selected.

ai-scientist.method: Orchestrates idea generation, novelty checking, code edits, executed experiments, plotting, manuscript writing and automated reviewing around supplied research templates.
ai-scientist.evidence: Inspected the pipeline, reviewer calibration and a generated code/manuscript case study.
ai-scientist.discovery_use: An end-to-end harness baseline and a source of candidate trajectories for studying research-stage failures.
ai-scientist.limits: Automated reviewer scores and completed manuscripts do not independently establish scientific correctness or novelty. Initial templates and editable evaluation code are important experimental controls. The expanded Nature 2026 version is separately downloaded and body-screened in the version audit; it explicitly reports human filtering for workshop submissions and distinguishes workshop from main-conference acceptance.

classification_review.rationale: Orchestrates idea generation, novelty checking, code edits, executed experiments, plotting, manuscript writing and automated reviewing around supplied research templates. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

agent-laboratory.method: Specialized agents perform literature review, experimentation and report writing, with optional human feedback and a pool of scored experimental programs.
agent-laboratory.evidence: Inspected the solver's execution/reflection loop and report-review mechanism, including its discussion of unhelpful experimental outputs.
agent-laboratory.discovery_use: Shows how successful and failed execution feedback can be captured separately from the final report for training data collection.
agent-laboratory.limits: Human-provided ideas and intermediate guidance affect autonomy. LLM-generated scientific scores need independent measurement and cannot substitute for held-out experimental evaluation.

classification_review.rationale: Specialized agents perform literature review, experimentation and report writing, with optional human feedback and a pool of scored experimental programs. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

agentrxiv.method: Allows independent agent laboratories to publish/retrieve reports from a shared archive and build on previous computational research.
agentrxiv.evidence: Inspected the archive workflow and repeated prompting-technique experiments on MATH-500, including cost/speed tradeoffs of multiple labs.
agentrxiv.discovery_use: A model of population-level research memory and reusable discovery artifacts beyond one agent's context window.
agentrxiv.limits: Repeated work on a fixed visible benchmark can overfit. Shared reports can propagate unsupported claims; faster progress must be compared at equal total compute.

classification_review.rationale: Allows independent agent laboratories to publish/retrieve reports from a shared archive and build on previous computational research. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

ai-researcher.method: Coordinates literature/implementation analysis, idea generation, algorithm implementation, validation and writing through iterative specialized-agent feedback.
ai-researcher.evidence: Inspected the refinement architecture and Scientist-Bench's guided versus open exploration setup across 22 reference papers.
ai-researcher.discovery_use: Useful for separating implementation success, idea quality and empirical improvement when evaluating a research harness.
ai-researcher.limits: Reference-paper guidance and automated review introduce substantial priors. A small ML-domain evaluation does not establish general scientific autonomy.

classification_review.rationale: Coordinates literature/implementation analysis, idea generation, algorithm implementation, validation and writing through iterative specialized-agent feedback. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

curie.method: Architect/technician agents interact through modules that validate experimental procedures, partition plans, enforce dependencies and retain structured experiment knowledge.
curie.evidence: Inspected validation and scheduling rules, the 46-question four-domain benchmark, and conclusion-accuracy results.
curie.discovery_use: A concrete harness contribution: experimental control and provenance can be evaluated independently of policy parameter updates.
curie.limits: Computer-science experiments dominate; strong within-benchmark gains do not show transfer to physical discovery. Validation modules themselves can miss confounds.

classification_review.rationale: Architect/technician agents interact through modules that validate experimental procedures, partition plans, enforce dependencies and retain structured experiment knowledge. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

robin.method: Combines literature and data-analysis agents to suggest therapeutic hypotheses, interpret laboratory outputs and propose subsequent hypotheses.
robin.evidence: Inspected iterative phagocytosis-assay/RNA-seq analysis and the explicit scientist-upload and experiment-selection steps.
robin.discovery_use: Provides a real laboratory-feedback case with an identifiable hypothesis/experiment/update cycle.
robin.limits: Scientists perform experiments and sometimes alter suggested assays. Cellular assay findings and proposed mechanisms are not clinical validation; human work must be counted in autonomy claims.

classification_review.rationale: Combines literature and data-analysis agents to suggest therapeutic hypotheses, interpret laboratory outputs and propose subsequent hypotheses. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

kosmos.attribution_note: Selected lead-team affiliations; the complete multi-institution author block is in the consulted PDF.
kosmos.method: Data-analysis and literature agents share a structured world model while pursuing multi-cycle research objectives and producing source-linked reports.
kosmos.evidence: Inspected the workflow/accuracy breakdown and several retrospective findings compared with human analyses.
kosmos.discovery_use: Motivates long-horizon memory, claim-level provenance and discovery-quality-versus-compute measurements.
kosmos.limits: Expert time-equivalence estimates are subjective; retrospective rediscovery differs from prospective experimental validation. Report accuracy and novelty require independent auditing.

classification_review.rationale: Data-analysis and literature agents share a structured world model while pursuing multi-cycle research objectives and producing source-linked reports. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

virtual-lab.method: A principal-investigator agent coordinates specialized scientist/critic agents through meetings, producing a computational nanobody design pipeline with human guidance.
virtual-lab.evidence: Inspected pipeline scoring, experimental binding discussion and the statement that humans executed scripts and contributed infrastructure code.
virtual-lab.discovery_use: A real experimental-validation case for distinguishing proposal generation, computational scoring and physical evidence.
virtual-lab.limits: The word virtual describes the agent team, not the entire evidence source. Human execution and wet-lab work remain substantial; binding assays are not clinical efficacy. The journal PDF was downloaded from an academic teaching mirror after the publisher PDF endpoint failed.

classification_review.rationale: A principal-investigator agent coordinates specialized scientist/critic agents through meetings, producing a computational nanobody design pipeline with human guidance. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

chemcrow.method: A ReAct-style LLM invokes specialized chemistry/search/computation tools, with cloud-connected synthesis and a human-query tool.
chemcrow.evidence: Inspected chemical-use-case expert evaluations, reported RoboRXN synthesis execution and the tool interface descriptions.
chemcrow.discovery_use: Illustrates the difference between a capable scientific tool harness and a policy trained to choose informative experiments.
chemcrow.limits: Demonstrating synthesis of known molecules is not automatically new knowledge. Proprietary services, human interaction and expert judgment constrain reproducibility.

classification_review.rationale: A ReAct-style LLM invokes specialized chemistry/search/computation tools, with cloud-connected synthesis and a human-query tool. Its main contribution integrates the harness, tools, execution infrastructure, or multi-agent research workflow.

react.method: Interleaves language reasoning, environment actions and returned observations in one trajectory, using prompting and optional fine-tuning.
react.evidence: Inspected the history-conditioned policy formulation, QA comparisons and ALFWorld/WebShop evaluation setup.
react.discovery_use: A basic action/observation protocol for instrumenting discovery trajectories and comparing reasoning-only with interactive evidence acquisition.
react.limits: Retrieving existing answers and completing prescribed tasks do not establish discovery. Example trajectories and tool availability are part of the effective policy.

classification_review.rationale: Interleaves language reasoning, environment actions and returned observations in one trajectory, using prompting and optional fine-tuning. Its main contribution specifies how candidate explanations or artifacts are proposed, searched, tested, or selected.

reflexion.method: Stores verbal self-reflections from evaluated trials in memory and conditions later attempts on them without gradient-based policy updates.
reflexion.evidence: Inspected the actor/evaluator/reflection loop and ALFWorld, QA and programming experiments; some figure glyphs in the PDF are corrupted, while body text is readable.
reflexion.discovery_use: An essential memory-only baseline for distinguishing harness adaptation from test-time weight training.
reflexion.limits: The term verbal reinforcement learning does not imply parameter RL. An incorrect evaluator or misleading reflection can reinforce errors.

classification_review.rationale: Stores verbal self-reflections from evaluated trials in memory and conditions later attempts on them without gradient-based policy updates. Its main contribution concerns updates from feedback during deployment or across continuing investigations.

voyager.method: An LLM proposes exploration tasks, writes executable skills and refines them from environment/error feedback; validated skills enter a growing retrieval library.
