paper-d413c98db0f6141e.method: Constructs 30 projects from public documents, producing 7,140 records and 1,613 questions across evidence reasoning, conflict resolution, and unanswerability. Applies programmatic and LLM validation with a small blind human audit. Evaluates ten multimodal models using retrieved records, varying retrieval budget and retriever size, with automatic answer judging.
paper-d413c98db0f6141e.evidence: The strongest evaluated model scores 52.6% with ten retrieved records and 68.0% with fifty. At ten records, its cross-source and temporal conflict accuracy is 36.3% and 32.5%. Accuracy drops from 83.3% on single-text-record questions to 27.5% on questions requiring multiple images. More retrieval improves recall without consistently improving weaker models' answers.
paper-d413c98db0f6141e.discovery_use: Directly evaluates knowledge verification under conflicting and changing evidence, including recognizing insufficient information. These capabilities support discovery agents deciding what is established, superseded, or still unknown.
paper-d413c98db0f6141e.limits: Simulated records from 30 source documents may not represent real enterprise complexity. Generation, validation, and final judging depend heavily on LLMs; human validation includes only fifty accepted items. Unanswerable questions comprise 5.4% of the benchmark. The baseline evaluates retrieved-context answering rather than autonomous investigation. Although the paper claims artifact availability, the verified author repository lists the dataset and evaluation toolkit as forthcoming.

classification_review.rationale: Directly evaluates knowledge verification under conflicting and changing evidence, including recognizing insufficient information. These capabilities support discovery agents deciding what is established, superseded, or still unknown.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-ff655bd3f5066c0f.method: Experts annotate 1,027 questions over 392 videos, followed by independent review and model-assisted shortcut screening. Models return answers and separate audio and visual intervals. Coverage Grounded Score measures evidence hits; Bottleneck Grounded Score multiplies answer correctness by the weaker modality's temporal IoU. Evaluation covers 24 models and a human reference.
paper-ff655bd3f5066c0f.evidence: Gemini3.7-Flash reaches 79.4% answer accuracy, 70.8% coverage score, and 35.1% bottleneck score, compared with 94.3% human bottleneck performance. Its Level-3 accuracy remains 79.1%, while bottleneck performance falls to 12.3%. Modality ablations support complementary audiovisual inputs, and native audio outperforms transcripts for the evaluated MiMo model.
paper-ff655bd3f5066c0f.discovery_use: The benchmark directly evaluates whether conclusions can be checked against localized supporting evidence. Its joint correctness-and-grounding protocol provides a concrete evaluation method for evidence verification in discovery agents.
paper-ff655bd3f5066c0f.limits: Temporal overlap does not establish semantic understanding or causal use of evidence. Coverage scoring permits broad intervals, and shortcut rates depend on the tested models. Videos span 1–12 minutes with selected content characteristics; broader linguistic and cultural coverage remains unestablished. Human replay conditions differ from model inference. Some diagnostic counts differ between the main text and appendix.

classification_review.rationale: The benchmark directly evaluates whether conclusions can be checked against localized supporting evidence. Its joint correctness-and-grounding protocol provides a concrete evaluation method for evidence verification in discovery agents.

paper-50d8cd71040f538b.method: The core contains 7,800 items from 13 generated families with independently implemented answer solvers, contrast groups, and three difficulty levels. sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-5a683d7a781fb5bd.method: Estimates a shared linear mixing matrix with one of four representation-learning approaches, resolves permutation and scaling using acyclicity, and tests recovered noise dependencies for bidirected edges. Evaluates synthetic domain scalings, mixtures, masking, and interventions over 20 seeds, plus semisynthetic manufacturing data, against LiNGAM, BANG, DCD, RCD, and FCI.
paper-5a683d7a781fb5bd.evidence: Theory establishes directed-edge recovery conditional on noise identifiability; complete confounding recovery additionally requires no cancellation. paper-5a683d7a781fb5bd.discovery_use: Provides identification theory and practical methods for discovering causal relations and latent confounding from heterogeneous domains, directly contributing to causal representations of unknown structure.
paper-5a683d7a781fb5bd.limits: Requires linear mechanisms, invariant directed coefficients, identifiable disturbances, and suitable cross-domain variability; selection bias and observed-to-latent effects are excluded. Population identification guarantees do not guarantee finite-sample recovery. Baselines sometimes receive pooled data or fewer samples because of computational limits. Appendix domain-count descriptions contain inconsistencies. No first-party code URL was verified despite a code-availability statement. Only pages 1 and 2 were visually inspected.

classification_review.rationale: Provides identification theory and practical methods for discovering causal relations and latent confounding from heterogeneous domains, directly contributing to causal representations of unknown structure.

paper-b34e9d0c4929185b.method: Decomposes 901 findings into 2,190 atomic claims and reconstructs analyses using curated data and manuals. Numerical reproduction generally requires agreement within 5%, alongside evidence and method checks. Robustness testing combines independent reports, structured single-choice perturbations and direct coding-agent investigation. Only fully reproduced findings qualify, and model-assessed consequences are graded on an ordinal nine-point scale.
paper-b34e9d0c4929185b.evidence: The reproduction agent matches 1,694 claims, or 77.4%; 59.8% of failures are attributed to data issues. Across 579 eligible findings, at least one analyst flags 55, or 9.5%, as potentially consequential; only 14 receive flags from multiple analysts. Expert examination of ten flagged cases finds nine do not establish consequential changes under defensible alternatives, while one needs further review. paper-b34e9d0c4929185b.limits: The flag rate is not a verified rate of scientific reversals. Expert review covers ten cases and uses one medically knowledgeable coauthor, leaving precision and recall uncertain. Restriction to fully reproduced findings introduces selection effects. Historical data, software approximations and incompletely specified analyses limit reconstruction. Model grading does not independently validate all code or recover undocumented author choices. paper-9f0b1afaa9684d4a.method: Characterizes leaves through linear relationships between residual cross-product covariance vectors, recursively recovers causal order, then constructs surrogate instruments for effect estimation. Finite-sample estimation combines goodness-of-fit statistics, order-constrained generalized method of moments and edge thresholding. The evaluation section, retrieved from the primary PDF, compares graph recovery with LiNGAM, RFCI and LRpS-GES over random, hub and chain graphs.
paper-9f0b1afaa9684d4a.evidence: The paper establishes identification, consistency and asymptotic-normality results under its assumptions. Simulations use 100 repetitions per setting and report near-perfect graph recovery except for smaller-sample chain graphs, with lower effect-estimation error than LiNGAM. The mouse application estimates differing regulatory networks; these are observational findings rather than experimentally confirmed edges.
paper-9f0b1afaa9684d4a.discovery_use: Develops general causal-structure identification and estimation under hidden confounding, directly expanding methods for learning unknown causal representations. The contribution is methodological rather than confined to its biological application.
paper-9f0b1afaa9684d4a.limits: Identification requires auxiliary variables uncorrelated with structural errors, orthogonality with distinct-error products, and a full-column-rank heteroscedastic covariance matrix, implying at least as many auxiliaries as primary variables. Invalid instruments here can violate exclusion; arbitrary instrument-confounder dependence is not covered. Simulations satisfy the identification assumptions by construction. Nonlinear primary-variable relations remain an extension. The biological application lacks an independently known complete graph. Evaluation text was checked, but its plots were not among the supplied visual pages. Searches found no verified first-party release.

classification_review.rationale: Develops general causal-structure identification and estimation under hidden confounding, directly expanding methods for learning unknown causal representations. The contribution is methodological rather than confined to its biological application.

paper-f73eeee30c4bf920.method: Reconstructs original and corrected plans from completed histories while freezing evaluator context before the correction. paper-f73eeee30c4bf920.limits: This challenge set measures recognition among supplied alternatives, not plan generation, research execution or the prevalence of failures across scientific work. Model-in-the-loop selection limits population-level conclusions. Cases cluster within projects, reference plans are retrospectively reconstructed, clients expose different reading tools, and effort settings do not match compute budgets. paper-e0e322c3332399a4.method: A Proposer selects tasks and a Director constructs graphs executed by frozen Workers. Each five-rollout group randomly hides one candidate skill from three rollouts. Hidden-context outcome diversity trains the Proposer; correctness contrasts feed a Bayesian-bootstrap ledger for skill withdrawal, admission, and restoration. Failures also produce revised or newly distilled skills.
paper-e0e322c3332399a4.evidence: Five-run results report the best scores among evaluated baselines on twelve benchmarks, including six held-out benchmark distributions, with skills disabled at evaluation. Reported scores include 81.33% on AIME 2026 and 42.81% on SWE-Bench. Ablations support both curriculum selection and skill withdrawal. The trained Director also improves six alternative Worker backbones without retraining.
paper-e0e322c3332399a4.discovery_use: Directly relevant to recursive self-improvement and curriculum discovery: an orchestrator learns which tasks remain learnable as external skills are removed, while randomized comparisons guide skill retirement.
paper-e0e322c3332399a4.limits: Initial skills are manually customized by dataset, and the Proposer selects from supplied task candidates. Test sets contain only 128 items each, except 30 AIME problems. Outcome diversity can reflect Worker randomness rather than controllable learning progress; the appendix explicitly narrows the theoretical connection. Withdrawal bounds concern posterior expectations over tested tasks and require additional assumptions to transfer across policy, context, and distribution drift. These experiments do not establish indefinitely sustained open-ended improvement.

classification_review.rationale: Directly relevant to recursive self-improvement and curriculum discovery: an orchestrator learns which tasks remain learnable as external skills are removed, while randomized comparisons guide skill retirement.

paper-bc10433cad9d513d.method: Evaluated parent–child modifications enter a bounded strategy pool. Retrieval favors strong positive records, negative outcomes, category diversity, and reduced semantic redundancy. A scrubbed auditor digest produces exploration directives. Three meta-agents propose patches at different temperatures, and structural checks select one for evaluation. Five-run studies span five domains, with component and shuffled-failure controls.
paper-bc10433cad9d513d.evidence: Reported final medians match or exceed DGM-H across domains, while each system’s selected best checkpoint appears in 1.7–2.9 times fewer generations. paper-bc10433cad9d513d.limits: Several headline baselines are published results rather than reruns under the same gate. Polyglot selection uses a development subset included in the final evaluation, and routing changes confound some comparisons. Speed ratios compare each method’s own best checkpoint, not arrival at a fixed quality target. Classification is unvalidated, retrieval diversity is not independently ablated, and the audit dataset is confidential. Audit-risk accuracy also remains below the roughly 74% test-set majority-class rate implied by the appendix. No first-party public release was verified.

paper-a97c1f5a709e4de6.method: Agents first explore and write a workflow, then execute it. LLM annotators formalize workflows, segment trajectories, and judge semantic predicates; Lean or Python checks decidable properties. Penalty-only tool rewards target repetitive or vacuous actions. paper-a97c1f5a709e4de6.evidence: LAR-27B reports 84.2% on SWE-Bench-Verified and 77.3% on TerminalBench-2.1, versus 83.0% and 69.6% for its base. paper-a97c1f5a709e4de6.limits: Workflow formalization, segmentation, and semantic judgments are not formally guaranteed. Reported annotation failure rates are primarily assessed by another LLM with limited manual checking. Experiments do not establish scientific discovery performance or runtime verification. Training uses substantial compute. The verified public code release contains the workflow harness and TerminalBench evaluation kit but omits formalization, reward annotation, and RL training pipelines. The released LAR-27B card describes SWE-only filtered training, differing from the paper’s mixed-data recipe.

paper-9a7fdd3c6dd57014.method: The authors curate approximately 10,000 human and 3,000 robot video hours with synchronized camera trajectories, skeletons, and captions. paper-9a7fdd3c6dd57014.limits: The kinematic interface omits explicit contact and object dynamics, so visual prediction quality does not establish physically faithful causal simulation. Zero-shot means an unseen target dataset, while the embodiment may appear in other training sources. Policy-ranking correlations involve few checkpoints. Longer stable rollouts remain unresolved. paper-029806d18c63cad7.method: The study verifies 158 PHREEQC questions from 19 setups and compares inline reports, section-index retrieval, search, hybrid delivery, and instruction interventions. Controlled state interventions separate functional participation, feedback binding, retention benefit, and discovery efficiency.
paper-12f2f100744d125c.evidence: The formal results establish causal composition, bounded work, and risk reduction for accepted transitions under explicit audit-coverage assumptions. Existing component studies show program-selection retention gains of 24.65 and 36.65 points, but a direct support-loss selector is much stronger. None of these studies demonstrates the proposed recursive memory route or a beneficial multi-generation chain.
paper-12f2f100744d125c.discovery_use: Provides a substantive formal construction and evaluation framework for learning mechanisms that participate in generating their successors. This is relevant foundational work on learning to improve discovery, despite absent evidence of successful recursive chains.
paper-12f2f100744d125c.limits: No new experiment evaluates the central recursive construction, its discovery efficiency, or joint policy–memory benefits. Conditional admission guarantees assume valid simultaneous audit coverage and fresh information rather than supplying an implemented statistical procedure. Mutable rule languages are deliberately narrow, and an admissible improved successor need not exist. Component studies use distinct populations and endpoints and cannot be pooled into an RSI result. Raw trajectories, weights, and a public recursive implementation are unavailable in the described source package; no paper-specific release was verified.

paper-f8f021c90e8a1d58.method: Crosses three capability compositions, four interdependence structures, and three external-state evolution mechanisms on GAIA, LoCoBench, and OfficeQA Pro. Across 50 simulation replications per configuration, selected tuning pairs achieve power of 0.9686–1 and normalized Hamming error at most 0.0307. On 430 flood events, a range of extreme-sample sizes yields a valid order; favorable reachability errors of 0.098–0.114 improve modestly on the empty-graph value of 0.136.

paper-328d19a6d649c766.limits: Assumes nonnegative independent identically distributed innovations, common tail index, monotone homogeneous mechanisms, and acyclicity. General recovery concerns ancestry, not every direct edge. Shared storms violate the unconfounded model in the river application. The best river tuning is selected using the true graph, and automatic tuning remains unresolved. Simulation dimension and sample size increase together. Strong contemporary empirical method comparisons remain future work. Only the first page was visually supplied.

paper-c0e89760c2e30631.method: Statewise e-processes produce a persistent version space. Hypotheses are falsified, open, or certified according to their relation to that space. paper-c0e89760c2e30631.limits: Open-endedness expands hypotheses within fixed environmental, action, and background representations; it does not update the background contour or expand the underlying state space. Recovery needs model correctness, generator coverage, and information non-starvation, which falsifiability alone does not ensure. Stopping need not occur and certifies primary utility, not globally smallest explanations or optimal cost. Synthetic baselines also differ in action selection; precision excludes abstentions. Real-data tests and LLM-based scoring are exploratory, and certificates cover compiled statistical predicates rather than extra mechanistic wording. No first-party release was verified. paper-7c2e98f772c31d33.method: A conditional bound covers finite-depth pre-normalized transformers with bounded attention logits and nondegenerate normalization inputs. An exactly solvable relay model characterizes logarithmic corrections. Experiments compare trained and untrained Pythia and Qwen models using shared continuations, corrected signal estimators, bootstrap intervals, attention-path decomposition, and dilution-compensation interventions.
paper-7c2e98f772c31d33.evidence: The conditional offset bound scales as P times log(t) to power L−1 divided by t. Trained deep layers typically show finite-window decay exponents around 0.55–0.70, faster than untrained models. Compensating attention dilution suppresses or reverses measured decay. Mild boosts improve instruction adherence, but matched constant boosts perform similarly and stronger compensation substantially harms perplexity.
paper-7c2e98f772c31d33.discovery_use: It supplies theory and controlled measurements of prompt-information retention, a concrete foundation for understanding why long-horizon discovery agents lose instructions and earlier constraints despite retaining their context.
paper-7c2e98f772c31d33.limits: The theorem is asymptotic, with constants too large to predict observed trained-model windows. Its normalization assumption is checked only on sampled sequences. Conditional forgetting does not prove disappearance of accumulated influence in free generation. Model sizes, continuation sources, and behavioral samples are limited; some signal decay reflects changing offset direction. Per-head compensation shifts models far from their training distribution. The verified toolkit repository does not ship experimental result records.

classification_review.rationale: It supplies theory and controlled measurements of prompt-information retention, a concrete foundation for understanding why long-horizon discovery agents lose instructions and earlier constraints despite retaining their context.

paper-25be5f1bd7762386.method: Counterexample-Guided Partition Refinement proposes a symbolization, verifies conditioned subproblems, attempts repairs that add no symbols, and introduces new commitments when obstacles remain. Relative affine total unimodularity certifies exact LP relaxation for the structured setting. Neural CPR builds graphs from sampled descents and uses energy barriers and gradient changes to refine partitions. Evaluation covers six structured manipulation tasks and five neural-policy tasks, including two physical robot tasks.
paper-25be5f1bd7762386.evidence: Structured-task inference speedups range from 1.34 to 4.81 times the end-to-end reference, with success rates from 0.88 to 1.00. paper-25be5f1bd7762386.discovery_use: The paper contributes automatic invention and verification of useful abstract concepts for agent planning. Symbols are discovered from computational structure and optimization obstacles rather than selected from a predefined vocabulary, providing a concrete discovery-representation contribution.
paper-25be5f1bd7762386.limits: Exact guarantees depend on the stated matrix assumptions. Neural verification is exact only on sampled graphs; it does not certify the continuous landscape or practical solver convergence everywhere. Finding minimum symbol dimension is NP-hard, and bounded repair searches do not prove minimality. Linear symbol axes can be restrictive, longer horizons increase complexity, and insufficient sampling leaves unresolved regions. The main text's simplified exponential description should be read alongside the appendix's symbol-domain bound. Only supplied pages 3 and 7 were visually inspected.

paper-dd2dc379979e7af0.limits: Responses are synthesized from designer-specified mechanisms using empirical dataset conditions; this is controlled mechanism inference rather than recovery of the datasets' actual generating mechanisms. paper-65f2aa74e4cbffb5.method: Paired sandbox replays compare a search allocation with continuing without that allocation from the same restored state. paper-65f2aa74e4cbffb5.evidence: The main open-weight matrix reports average raw-token savings of 36.2% and uncached-token savings of 30.3% relative to full retrospective tree search, with a mean score difference of +0.23 points. Appendix scope statements also disagree about availability of that comparison. These results cannot support a unified frontier-performance claim. Deployment savings exclude source collection and update costs. The theoretical bound does not certify deployed predictions, margins, or closed-loop regret. Learning is mainly within benchmark; unseen-environment transfer is not established. Reliable restoration and sandbox isolation are required. paper-31ad9246f9a10e34.method: Each task receives original, evidence-preserving, withdrawal, and reversal versions, verified using a preregistered reference statistic. Canonical file rewriting removes metadata shortcuts. Fresh agent runs on each version audit both agent responsiveness and evaluator behavior. The study covers 18 selected single-cell questions and four synthetic genetics problems, three scaffolds, and five models. Follow-ups anonymize gene names, permit abstention, change judge instructions, and measure transformation consistency.
paper-31ad9246f9a10e34.evidence: Claude agents average 95% conventional accuracy and 83% accuracy without data, but only 41% evidence-grounded accuracy. On ten gene tasks, anonymization increases reversal-following from 58% to 93%. Standard benchmark and LLM-judge scores favor the original key over following reversed evidence, with flip AUC near 0.10–0.12. Grounding-focused judge prompts raise AUC above 0.7, while abstention reduces credit after evidence withdrawal. No single repair addresses every failure.
paper-31ad9246f9a10e34.discovery_use: Directly tests whether scientific agents derive conclusions from supplied evidence and whether evaluation rewards evidence-responsive reasoning, a central requirement for verifying discoveries.
paper-31ad9246f9a10e34.limits: The study selects 18 of 193 single-cell questions that admit a suitable statistic and supported key, limiting generalization. Biomni has one replicate; other models generally have three. Behavioral response patterns do not reveal internal reasoning mechanisms, and anonymization also removes semantic cues. Plain evidence-grounded accuracy accepts an answer change after withdrawal even without an appropriate insufficiency flag; strict scores are lower. Evaluators intentionally retain the original key after edits, so the audit measures robustness to evidence/key conflict rather than ordinary untouched-task accuracy. Responsiveness is necessary but insufficient for scientific quality. No first-party release was verified in the bounded search. Only two pages were visually inspected.

classification_review.rationale: Directly tests whether scientific agents derive conclusions from supplied evidence and whether evaluation rewards evidence-responsive reasoning, a central requirement for verifying discoveries.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-76e8130f572b6405.method: Per-item binary correctness differences feed restart betting processes initiated at every round. An alarm fires when the largest restart wealth crosses a threshold; its starting round estimates a change point, and the preceding retained artifact is returned. Theoretical analysis separates stopping validity from fixed-betting change-point localization. Experiments apply adaptive and fixed-mixture variants to SkillOpt and GEPA across three model families and five benchmarks.
paper-76e8130f572b6405.evidence: The three main benchmarks show token savings of 48.4–91.6%. On SearchQA, stopping at round 4 and returning round 1 gives 82.43% test accuracy versus 82.00% for the full run. GSM8K and OfficeQA differences are −0.80 and −1.16 percentage points, with intervals including zero. The detector stays inactive on an improving SpreadsheetBench trajectory and stops before a later answer-label exploit on LiveMath. GEPA experiments also save computation, although their token counts are estimated.
paper-76e8130f572b6405.discovery_use: Addresses when persistent agent self-improvement should stop and which learned artifact to retain, directly contributing to reliable and resource-aware recursive improvement.
paper-76e8130f572b6405.limits: Stopping validity assumes conditional independence across validation items; its applicability under adaptive reuse of a fixed validation set is not empirically established. The restart maximum guarantees an average false-alarm run length of at least 1/δ, not a global false-alarm probability bounded by δ. Localization requires stronger fixed-betting log-growth assumptions and is not proved for the adaptive scheme used in main results. Persistent low improvement is assumed, so later renewed gains may be missed. Confidence intervals containing zero do not prove performance equivalence. GEPA costs are estimated, and the method does not directly detect reward hacking. No first-party release was verified. Visual review covers only pages 1 and 2.

classification_review.rationale: Addresses when persistent agent self-improvement should stop and which learned artifact to retain, directly contributing to reliable and resource-aware recursive improvement.

paper-c49994cd61004d2c.method: A source-first search minimizes estimated local Fisher scores over bounded predecessor subsets. A size penalty then selects minimal parent completions. Regularized kernel Stein equations estimate the scores. Recovery guarantees require additive independent noise, regularity, sufficient conditioning size, positive separation margins, and controlled estimation error. Evaluation compares five methods on synthetic DAGs and three real reference-graph benchmarks.
paper-c49994cd61004d2c.evidence: At 200 variables and 100 observations, FiCS reaches mean directed-edge F1 of 0.637, versus 0.262 for DAGMA, 0.055 for SCORE, and 0.066 for NoGAM. Its advantage generally narrows with more observations. Full-prefix conditioning performs worse than bounded conditioning in the reported ablation. Real-data F1 values are 0.452, 0.538, and 0.563. Additional experiments show weaker performance on purely nonlinear mechanisms and heterogeneous Gaussian noise scales.
paper-c49994cd61004d2c.discovery_use: Introduces an identifiable causal-structure representation and recovery algorithm using bounded-dimensional distributional information, directly supporting discovery of unknown causal relationships.
paper-c49994cd61004d2c.limits: Conditioning size must cover maximum indegree, and this alone does not ensure the required ordering margin. Scores depend on measurement scale. Exhaustive subset search and dense kernel solves remain expensive. The theorem does not directly analyze the empirical bandwidth-and-ridge rule. CaPS failures are omitted from plotted averages, so compared instance sets can differ. Real references can exceed the parent cap; temporal dependence and possible hidden drivers fall outside the recovery assumptions. No first-party artifact release was verified.

Separate ideation and execution agents conduct research cycles; rubric completion and score improvement use distinct gates. Workers exchange distilled findings. Later stages generate baselines, ablations, diagnostics, claim-to-source maps, and independent manuscript audits. Evaluation includes 70 campaigns and detailed discovery case studies.
paper-4cca51b1d2fa9e6f.evidence: Query-conditioned adapter composition reaches 98.0% accuracy on synthetic multi-needle retrieval, versus approximately 52% for the strongest query-blind composition. A discovered optimizer matches or exceeds CMA-ES mean terminal return on five of seven unseen Brax tasks. One human-supervised Error Diffusion paper receives ALIFE acceptance after verification and edits. Shared knowledge accelerates search, but its final best-score advantage is not statistically significant.
paper-4cca51b1d2fa9e6f.discovery_use: The primary contribution is a research-agent orchestration system connecting falsifiable hypotheses, experiments, shared experience, verification, and scientific reporting.
paper-4cca51b1d2fa9e6f.limits: The 70-campaign paper-quality measure is an AI-review proxy. Only the co-created Error Diffusion paper receives external peer review, with meaningful human involvement. Rubrics miss evaluation-protocol changes in some RL runs, subsequently excluded by manual audit. Task drafting is not robust on larger problems; explicit literature search occurs mainly during writing. Synthetic retrieval transfer is untested, and optimizer evidence includes selection and meta-training uncertainty. This was a targeted review, not exhaustive reading of all 88 pages.

classification_review.rationale: The primary contribution is a research-agent orchestration system connecting falsifiable hypotheses, experiments, shared experience, verification, and scientific reporting.

paper-c643418cbbaee3ee.method: Entrants receive identical services and compete for three 20-minute rounds with rotating objectives and persistent patches. paper-c643418cbbaee3ee.evidence: Across 466 games, 12 agents, and 40 challenges, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 lead the expected-score standings. paper-c643418cbbaee3ee.discovery_use: CyberArena evaluates discovery of vulnerabilities and verification of repairs against changing opponents. Its adaptive environment and renewable challenge pipeline provide a concrete discovery-evaluation contribution beyond ordinary static security tasks.
paper-c643418cbbaee3ee.limits: Standings depend on the roster, challenge set, and statistical model; credible intervals are model-conditional. Health checks can miss broken workflows or checker discrimination. Six infrastructure-related captures remain in the standings, and sparse transcripts limit some screening. Behavioral audits are largely automated with selective human checks. Calibration covers only four entrants and six challenges. This was a targeted body and calibration-section review, not inspection of every appendix page.

classification_review.rationale: CyberArena evaluates discovery of vulnerabilities and verification of repairs against changing opponents. Its adaptive environment and renewable challenge pipeline provide a concrete discovery-evaluation contribution beyond ordinary static security tasks.

paper-2693639d7f34414f.method: Models continue Markdown-plus-XML trajectories after three reference steps, with at most one recovery hint per structural failure type. paper-2693639d7f34414f.limits: Scores depend substantially on serialization, prefixes, and scaffold choice. classification_review.rationale: ASAP evaluates pretrained agents through actual exploration, testing, recovery, and deep-research interaction. It provides a concrete protocol for measuring discovery-relevant behavior before post-training and diagnosing changes during learning.

paper-5fc86e0f1760f581.method: The detector matches canonicalized tool calls and identical observations. Each looping action is rejected in favor of the first later different, non-looping action from the same rollout, paired with the earlier context. LoRA DPO trains the policy without task rewards or external judges. Evaluation compares memory methods, inference controls, supervised training, alternative objectives, model sizes, and transfer environments.
paper-5fc86e0f1760f581.evidence: On compressed CodeGym tasks, Qwen3-8B loop rate falls from 57.3% to 6.1%, steps from 15.00 to 4.67, and success remains similar at 25.1% versus 25.9%. paper-5fc86e0f1760f581.discovery_use: The paper trains agents from their own interaction failures to avoid actions that yield no new information. Its concrete connection to discovery is preserving productive exploration under compressed memory, including transfer to web research tasks.
paper-5fc86e0f1760f581.limits: Exact-repeat detection misses some semantic redundancy and requires eventual recovery to mine a pair. Gemini compression plots select episodes where compression fired; matched-task analysis reduces the apparent effect. paper-b2d39182f36164f6.limits: Evidence concerns retrospective replay, synthetic personal identifiers, and registry-conditional matching rather than deployed clinical safety or formal privacy guarantees. paper-7c54f1424d2cec7d.method: Workers diagnose failures, evolve executable data-generation programs, train every candidate from a fixed base checkpoint, screen candidates on diagnostic subsets, and publish lessons plus fully evaluated scores. Experiments use six RSIBench-Data tasks under shared 16-hour and $500 limits, with worker-count, independent-worker, and alternative-agent-backbone comparisons.
paper-7c54f1424d2cec7d.evidence: With three workers, the mean absolute score gain over vanilla single-agent search is 10.70 percentage points. A fourth worker adds cost without improving the reported Verified score.
paper-7c54f1424d2cec7d.discovery_use: Agents autonomously propose, test, and retain training-data hypotheses across persistent search trees. This is a direct contribution to autonomous research and data-centric self-improvement.
paper-7c54f1424d2cec7d.limits: Search and official evaluation share task identities, so official scores verify selected checkpoints rather than establish held-out generalization. Recursion occurs in research strategy and memory; candidate weights restart from the same initialization. Reported results lack repeated-run uncertainty estimates. Worker scaling is tested on one benchmark, and shared-memory ablation removes both lessons and leaderboard, leaving their individual effects unresolved. The vanilla baseline also lacks several local search features, and the expenditure explanations are not independently isolated.

paper-c4a481fb0af0b157.limits: Evidence concerns reasoning benchmarks rather than autonomous discovery experiments. Training uses no answer labels for rewards, but checkpoint selection uses labeled validation accuracy. paper-25c116ef8f23e7f4.limits: Tests use 128 items per benchmark, except 30 AIME problems, and evaluate with learned components frozen. paper-9f94bbfaed11244a.limits: This is a conceptual and methodological synthesis, without a new empirical benchmark comparison or demonstrated discovery agent. Literature selection is representative and primarily Google Scholar based, rather than a documented systematic review. Evaluations use twelve BRIGHT datasets, three runs, a common model and seed, and 100 search iterations.
paper-4e39463f1abc150d.evidence: Quality-only search raises mean held-out nDCG@10 from 0.323 to 0.346, a 7.2% relative gain, winning nine of twelve datasets. paper-4e39463f1abc150d.discovery_use: Improves the generate–evaluate–revise loop used for algorithmic discovery by retaining structured evidence about previous program changes. The primary contribution concerns self-improving search, with retrieval serving as its main testbed.
paper-4e39463f1abc150d.limits: Metric changes are associated with entire edit sets, so the memory does not isolate individual components’ causal contributions. Main tests use one model and three runs; transfer starts from biology programs and covers four targets. Quality-only gains increase average serving tokens from 53.7k to 71.8k per query. Fewer iterations do not by themselves establish proportionally lower compute when evaluation costs vary. All 29 extracted pages were supplied; only pages 1 and 2 were visually inspected. No first-party release was verified; the OpenEvolve hint is a cited baseline.

paper-0fc21b6838fcff99.method: Analyze complete bundles and dependency provenance, execute listings without prior threat-based filtering, and assess execution traces separately. paper-0fc21b6838fcff99.evidence: Elevated capabilities appear in 70.2% of listings, high exposure in 25.7%, and non-benign verdicts in 5.4%. Among declaring listings, 59% under-declare capabilities. paper-0fc21b6838fcff99.limits: Exposure is not maliciousness or realized harm. Sampling does not support marketplace-wide prevalence estimates. paper-a5ff9a218203c4e6.method: Residual K-means constructs four SID codebooks with 49,152 possible addresses using 80 tokens. paper-65b6e8c3b7795317.method: A neural additive VAR models 23 variables with eight-year histories across 113 countries. Five nearly invariant variables enter only as predictors. Exact contribution ablations undergo one-sided Diebold–Mariano tests; a two-component mixture filters loss differentials. Conditional response curves characterize retained edges, while same-specification OLS and ridge models and five neural seeds provide comparisons.
paper-65b6e8c3b7795317.evidence: The reference run retains 160 forecast-necessary relationships and 84 dominant relationships, of which 73 are nonlinear in at least one context. Validation MSE is 0.2032 versus 0.2270 for ridge. Protective-belt relationships persist across all five seeds. GDP and literacy relationships appear in four seeds, while the direct agricultural-income relationship appears in none. Graph size ranges from 59 to 84 edges, with a 49-edge stable intersection.
paper-65b6e8c3b7795317.discovery_use: Contributes a reusable workflow for discovering and characterizing nonlinear dynamic dependencies, with explicit relationship tests and comparisons that diagnose apparent null findings. Its methodological contribution extends beyond the political application.
paper-65b6e8c3b7795317.limits: Forecast necessity establishes model-dependent predictive contribution, not intervention effects or freedom from confounding. Edge testing partly overlaps the training span; headline forecasting uses checkpoint-selection validation data, while the separately reserved final country years are unused. A stricter evaluation is asserted but not documented in the supplied robustness tables. Tests use HAC lag zero across pooled countries, and no multiple-testing adjustment is reported for 396 candidate edges. Replication materials are promised upon conditional acceptance; no public paper-specific release was verified.

paper-7f1896e8c90c3d01.method: The system maintains an evidence ledger, question frontier, and evidence requirements. Agents propose questions with parent-result provenance, specify populations, estimands, identification conditions, and measurement windows before outcomes, and conduct analyses with diagnostics and sensitivity checks. Of 1,079 screened questions, 756 receive unadjusted screening support; full-design evidence assigns 200 relations a population-derived state: 81 supported, two challenged, and 117 unresolved. Representative analyses identify blood-pressure-related pathways and substantial attenuation of one inflammation pathway after adjustment. NHANES mortality prediction reaches AUC 0.798; the refitted model does not clearly outperform the listed additive or boosted-tree baselines.
paper-7f1896e8c90c3d01.discovery_use: Directly addresses autonomous scientific investigation: empirical outcomes revise an evidence state and generate subsequent research questions, including competing explanations and unresolved evidence needs.

Screening support is unadjusted and excluded from evidence-state admission. Resource participant totals are not deduplicated. Predictive attribution identities establish mathematical transparency, not causal validity, and some phenotype test sets are small. The supplied sections do not isolate the benefit of adaptive question selection against a fixed-question agent. This review covers supplied pages 1–16 of 184. paper-0e9154958b34b909.method: A KL-regularized challenger objective defines an exponential-tilt target distribution. The implementation approximates refinement with five mutation sweeps, noisy agreement scores, a repetition penalty, and Metropolis-style acceptance. Majority-answer pseudo-labels and an agreement filter produce GRPO training data. Three model scales are compared with R-Zero and a matched-candidate no-walk ablation across mathematical and general-domain benchmarks.
paper-0e9154958b34b909.evidence: After three rounds, DEO reaches mathematical AVG7 scores of 28.30, 47.57, and 53.60 at the three scales, exceeding the listed R-Zero aggregates by 2.36, 1.64, and 0.72 points. Reported wall-clock reductions are 52–61%. Improvements over no walk are 0.79–1.89 points, with mixed individual-benchmark rankings. A Claude generator raises the 4B solver's AVG7 from 47.57 to 49.60 without supplying its training labels.

paper-0e9154958b34b909.limits: The theorem assumes exact sampling, a different reward and solver update, local gradient dominance, and a localization budget unverified for LLMs. Its guarantee preserves initial modal answers and therefore certifies sharpening rather than acquisition of previously unavailable answers. Practical selection omits the proposal-density correction and uses unverified pseudo-labels. R-Zero uses larger question pools; no walk uses less total compute. Repeated AMC/AIME rows are not independent problems, and no statistical superiority is established. No official artifact release was verified.

Typed skills and verifiers are retained and forked when revised. Reconstruction tools undergo additional variant checks; stages stop on budget exhaustion. Evaluation covers HOI4D reconstruction, OakInk retargeting, eleven physical tasks with ten trials each, and sequential processing of 100 EgoDex videos.
paper-33b8ee2d6304a602.evidence: Reported OakInk success is 85.7% versus 81.0% for the strongest baseline. Learned policies achieve 63.6% average physical-task success versus 18.2% for SPIDER. Processing 100 videos produces 100 verified episodes in 210 hours, with later reuse reducing per-video time. The sequential experiment reaches 85 skills and 168 verifiers; the later combined library contains 103 and 188.

paper-33b8ee2d6304a602.limits: Incomplete verifiers can admit semantic or geometric errors that persist in the library, and simulation checks do not ensure real-world force-sensitive success. paper-9752f967ba715846.method: HBSP updates Bayesian residual skill posteriors from session feedback. SOCA constructs order-consistent, acyclic candidate preferences and ordinal trajectory credit. paper-9752f967ba715846.limits: Evidence concerns simulated behavior and adaptation within the scored cohort, without established clinical efficacy, disjoint-client transfer, or scientific-discovery performance. Shared adaptation couples client outcomes. Ablations do not freeze both learning paths together or isolate SOCA's mechanisms. Supplementary MusPsy and archived training traces lack verified linkage to main runs. paper-b62cde245db5c0cf.method: An orchestrator coordinates gap-finding, innovation, and report-writing agents with separate paper-reading and review roles. The 2.77-million-idea corpus supports retrieval; 277 target papers form the held-out test set.
paper-b62cde245db5c0cf.evidence: On Qwen3.6-27B, the trained system scores 74.6 versus 60.6 for the strongest matched-backbone baseline: a 14.0-point difference. Its untrained harness already scores 73.5, so training adds 1.1 overall points. Cross-domain retrieval improves novelty. Human comparisons favor the trained system, but its advantage over its own untrained harness is not statistically significant.
paper-b62cde245db5c0cf.discovery_use: Directly trains agents to identify research gaps, transfer mechanisms across fields, and formulate grounded scientific hypotheses and evaluation plans.
paper-b62cde245db5c0cf.limits: Proposal scores measure pre-execution proxies rather than demonstrated scientific success. The retrieval cutoff cannot exclude knowledge retained in model parameters; title-only contamination probes are limited. Human evaluation covers 50 papers. Review covers supplied body and selected appendix pages, not every page of the 36-page PDF. The repository provides code and a dataset link, without a verified trained-checkpoint release.

classification_review.rationale: Directly trains agents to identify research gaps, transfer mechanisms across fields, and formulate grounded scientific hypotheses and evaluation plans.

paper-e7d4b4cbecd5681d.method: Literature analysis and paired thought experiments motivate active sensing, evidence-gated safety memory, feasible recovery, and directed simulation testing. paper-e7d4b4cbecd5681d.evidence: The conceptual contribution links missed relationships, stale history, and infeasible recovery into one end-to-end account. paper-e7d4b4cbecd5681d.limits: The architecture, tests, and arena are proposals rather than implemented or validated artifacts. gollum.method: Jointly adapts language representations and a Gaussian-process surrogate through marginal likelihood, using predictive uncertainty to select subsequent experiments.

paper-ba5b84051bbc46cb.method: Training data select candidate ancestors and fit matched reduced and augmented conditional models. Held-out likelihood gains measure the contribution of a candidate response and, when supported, its intervention assignment. Calibration and acyclic projection produce the graph. Population identification requires nonparent separation and parent detectability; reported implementations use Gaussian or Poisson mean models.
paper-ba5b84051bbc46cb.evidence: The supplied results discussion reports improved continuous-simulation recovery with proxy adjustment. Count simulations expose a tradeoff: PABM produces better automatically selected graphs, while ARGEN has better ranking and recovery at matched graph sizes. The K562 illustration selects 52 edges versus ARGEN’s 168, but its association diagnostics cannot establish direct-edge or orientation accuracy.
paper-ba5b84051bbc46cb.discovery_use: Develops a method for distinguishing direct causal relationships from downstream intervention responses, a concrete capability for constructing discovery representations.
paper-ba5b84051bbc46cb.limits: Proxy informativeness alone does not establish the strong, generally untestable separation conditions. Sample splitting does not guarantee valid p-values, and the adaptive implementation’s coverage and calibration remain unestablished. Mean-only fits can miss variance or shape effects. K562 proxy adequacy is unresolved. This was a targeted review of supplied sections from 38 pages. No first-party public release was verified in the bounded search.

classification_review.rationale: Develops a method for distinguishing direct causal relationships from downstream intervention responses, a concrete capability for constructing discovery representations.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-d4efb0c6a2ce0b19.method: A transition operator formed from contemporaneous and lagged matrices recursively predicts missing states while preserving measured entries. Optimization differentiates through completion and combines masked structural residuals, sparsity penalties and a differentiable contemporaneous acyclicity constraint.
paper-d4efb0c6a2ce0b19.evidence: Synthetic experiments report stronger recovery as missingness increases, with competitive complete-data baselines. On small semi-synthetic fMRI networks, ITSY has the highest F1 in all four reported settings, ranging from 0.48 to 0.62; PCMCI+ has lower SHD throughout. The fMRI experiment evaluates only lagged edges.
paper-d4efb0c6a2ce0b19.discovery_use: Addresses learning contemporaneous and lagged causal structure from incomplete observations, supporting discovery representations when measurement windows contain missing data.
paper-d4efb0c6a2ce0b19.limits: Evidence concerns stationary, causally sufficient, linear first-order dynamics with MCAR masks. It does not establish performance under informative missingness, asynchronous clocks or latent confounding. Appendix B acknowledges that weighting does not fully recover accumulated innovation noise across missing intervals, qualifying the noise-correction claim. The listed PCMCI+ minimum lag of one also complicates contemporaneous comparisons. No first-party public release was verified.

classification_review.rationale: Addresses learning contemporaneous and lagged causal structure from incomplete observations, supporting discovery representations when measurement windows contain missing data.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-6b6e5337c5fddd67.method: Population identification assumes strict positivity and weighting faithfulness. The implementation learns softmax sample weights by minimizing pairwise weighted HSIC, monitors effective sample size, and selects boundary members through weighted Pearson tests. Subset-based boundary comparisons recover neighbors and colliders, followed by Meek orientation rules.
paper-6b6e5337c5fddd67.evidence: Synthetic evaluations compare CPDAG-converted outputs from PC, GES, LiNGAM, NOTEARS, GraNDAG and GOLEM. At ten variables, DCD reports F1 of 0.58 for functional mechanisms and 0.78 for MLP mechanisms. Noise experiments favor DCD beyond low-noise regimes, while PC and GES outperform it on some ER topologies. Performance declines with graph size.
paper-6b6e5337c5fddd67.discovery_use: Introduces distribution reweighting for discovering Markov boundaries and causal equivalence classes, directly contributing to learning unknown causal structure.
paper-6b6e5337c5fddd67.limits: Graph guarantees assume causal sufficiency, Markov faithfulness and an oracle boundary identifier. Pairwise HSIC approximates mutual independence, and Pearson correlation can miss nonlinear dependence required by the population theorem. Weight concentration can discard information; very low noise and high dimensionality are difficult. Boundary enumeration scales exponentially with maximum boundary size. Evaluation is synthetic. Supplementary code is stated, but no public first-party release was verified.

classification_review.rationale: Introduces distribution reweighting for discovering Markov boundaries and causal equivalence classes, directly contributing to learning unknown causal structure.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-721958fe0d5a8c2d.method: The benchmark contains 94 tasks from 15 studies and eight evaluated workflows. Expensive single-task simulations are precomputed; agents prepare inputs, analyze outputs or execute lighter calculations. Workflows execute their calculations within a five-hour budget. Hidden references grade numerical results and input settings. Four agents using three LLMs are evaluated.
paper-721958fe0d5a8c2d.evidence: Full-guidance single-task pass rates are 66.0–90.4% in MatClaw and 91.5% for Sol in Codex CLI. Reduced-guidance workflow rates are 50%, 54% and 75% across the three MatClaw agents. Scientific errors account for 38 of 50 workflow failures. Agents repeatedly continue despite diagnostic anomalies printed in their own outputs.
paper-721958fe0d5a8c2d.discovery_use: Directly evaluates scientific agents on research execution, methodological reasoning and recognition of erroneous results, making it a concrete discovery-evaluation contribution.
paper-721958fe0d5a8c2d.limits: Tasks reconstruct selected research steps and exclude studies proposing new ideas or concepts, so scores do not establish autonomous novel discovery. Strong agents approach saturation on guided single tasks; harder conditions contain fewer runs and different task sets. Fixed graders may reject valid alternatives. Resource budgets differ, selection is partly manual, and about 1 TB of reproduction intermediates is unreleased. The public repository is associated explicitly in the paper and verified by the supplied API check and repository page.

classification_review.rationale: Directly evaluates scientific agents on research execution, methodological reasoning and recognition of erroneous results, making it a concrete discovery-evaluation contribution.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-b0a747f7d53aca09.method: An observer classifier trains on detached encoder features. Its true-class versus strongest-competitor probability margin controls a sigmoid smoothing coefficient. The plug-in augments four spherical representation objectives, followed by frozen-encoder linear probing and existing open-set scoring functions. Evaluation uses three fine-grained Semantic Shift Benchmark datasets and three training seeds.
paper-b0a747f7d53aca09.evidence: Most method, dataset and scoring combinations improve, with exceptions. The highlighted 4.70% relative OSCR gain corresponds to 64.47 rising to 67.51, a 3.04 percentage-point increase. Compactness improves in 11 of 12 settings and dispersion in all 12. Ablations show small average benefits beyond batch-mean smoothing schedules, while norm-based unknown separation improves despite slightly worse angular separation.
paper-b0a747f7d53aca09.discovery_use: Improves representation training for detecting previously unseen classes, directly supporting the collection’s open-world recognition direction.
paper-b0a747f7d53aca09.limits: Evidence is limited to three image benchmarks and one backbone; the method rejects unknowns without learning new classes. Several results regress, and sample-specific assignment benefits are inconsistent. The manuscript disagrees on validation fold counts and seed identities, and modifies the original ConOSR batching procedure. Benefits depend on a nonzero base smoothing coefficient. Supplementary code is stated, but no public first-party release was verified.

classification_review.rationale: Improves representation training for detecting previously unseen classes, directly supporting the collection’s open-world recognition direction.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-3092c4571c115f82.method: Qwen3-32B agents operate within explicit budget, acceptance-quota, funding, and attrition rules. Submissions retrieve temporally eligible SciEvo papers rather than conduct original experiments. Evaluations span 61 worlds, including matched exploration-strategy populations, population-growth/resubmission interventions, output-capacity comparisons, and a funding-cutoff analysis.
paper-3092c4571c115f82.evidence: Resubmission raises year-ten reviews per active researcher from 2.25 to 6.64 without population growth; population growth alone yields 2.07. Cautious exploration balances citation outcomes with institutional success and maintains greater topic diversity. Doubling submission intensity increases accepted output while reducing participation. Narrow funding wins show no detectable subsequent funding advantage over three years.
paper-3092c4571c115f82.discovery_use: Provides a controlled research-agent environment for evaluating exploration strategies and persistent feedback through publication, funding, memory, and attrition. Its discovery connection is evaluating conditions that sustain research exploration, rather than generating new scientific findings.
paper-3092c4571c115f82.limits: Results depend on one LLM, fixed research directions, retrieved existing papers, abstract resource costs, and prescribed review behavior. Reviewers are explicitly prompted to concentrate scores near rejection. Some intervention comparisons have one world per condition, so paper-level intervals cannot establish across-world uncertainty. Workload ratios use year-end active populations and are not necessarily mean assignments among survivors. Citation metrics do not directly establish scientific quality or real-world policy effects. The simulation corpus is described as a planned release.

classification_review.rationale: Provides a controlled research-agent environment for evaluating exploration strategies and persistent feedback through publication, funding, memory, and attrition. Its discovery connection is evaluating conditions that sustain research exploration, rather than generating new scientific findings.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-0cf18f180d63c3e4.method: A fixed curator constructs observations from a persistent Git workspace; a meta-reasoner issues work orders to fresh executors. A generative critic predicts remaining return using categorical next-token probabilities. Shared actor–critic training assigns delayed credit across complete episodes using asynchronous buffers. Evaluations compare harnesses, token-level and decision-level critics, proxy versus terminal supervision, and cross-environment policy transfer.
paper-0cf18f180d63c3e4.evidence: The decision-level generative critic achieves mean held-out RMSE of 0.214 versus 0.324 for its token-level generative counterpart. MIRA solves all 30 advanced theorem problems in each of three trials, although token-matched continuation recovers most baseline deficits. The cross-environment policy improves primary gold outcomes over untrained MIRA across all four learning environments. Environment-specific MIRA-AC instead reduces BNLearn successes from 76 to 48; the cross-environment policy reaches 84.
paper-0cf18f180d63c3e4.discovery_use: Directly trains research agents to choose investigations and stopping decisions from delayed outcomes, with evaluations in symbolic regression, physics discovery, causal discovery, and architecture research.
paper-0cf18f180d63c3e4.limits: Curation and execution remain fixed. BNLearn is excluded from cross-environment actor training but included in critic pretraining, limiting claims of unseen-environment transfer. Shared-model comparisons also change initialization, so they do not isolate parameter sharing. Proxy alignment is uncharacterized, behavioral judgments are descriptive, and long architecture campaigns provide limited replication. Learning uses LoRA and does not test investigations lasting hours or days. Review covers supplied pages 1–17 and 43 of 47, with only the two supplied pages visually inspected. No paper-specific public release was verified; the hinted Qwen checkpoint is a baseline.

classification_review.rationale: Directly trains research agents to choose investigations and stopping decisions from delayed outcomes, with evaluations in symbolic regression, physics discovery, causal discovery, and architecture research.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-74664ec24514d549.method: Combines predictions for every candidate document with residual corrections weighted by logged selection and continuation probabilities. Shrinkage controls variance; partial-identification intervals handle inaccessible documents. Evaluations include 1,200 MS2 trajectories, 216 public-agent trajectories, controlled simulations, and 4,800 paired selection–stopping interventions.
paper-74664ec24514d549.evidence: On the main MS2 comparison, MAE falls from 0.1743 to 0.1583 and ranking sensitivity from 0.2445 to 0.1481. Public-agent results at two selections show 60.1% lower MAE and 87.2% lower ranking sensitivity than Opened Mean. At matched MAE, 10 of 28 comparisons favor CESS stability, with 18 inconclusive. Corrected-estimate contrasts poorly track directly measured selection-policy effects.
paper-74664ec24514d549.discovery_use: Directly advances evaluation of research agents by auditing whether adaptive evidence collection distorts their conclusions. Its separation of evidence-pool estimation from causal policy attribution is relevant to knowledge verification.
paper-74664ec24514d549.limits: The target represents a specified finite pool and aggregation rule, rather than open-web truth or report quality. Unbiasedness applies to the raw estimator under correct logged probabilities and overlap; shrinkage and clipping change that guarantee. Benefits over strong shrinkage baselines are mixed: at matched sensitivity, CESS has higher MAE in 10 of 28 comparisons. Ten-round PERSPECTRUM direction disagreement worsens relative to Opened Mean. Public-agent transfer replaces the search interface with a controlled pool. No first-party artifact release was verified.

classification_review.rationale: Directly advances evaluation of research agents by auditing whether adaptive evidence collection distorts their conclusions. Its separation of evidence-pool estimation from causal policy attribution is relevant to knowledge verification.

paper-1ad6e160560ae715.method: Uses Executable Operating Protocols, product adapters, bounded review–repair flows, and provenance-backed memory. A twelve-iteration HSTU deployment supplies incidents for ExecML: 96 hidden-oracle tasks per repository on HSTU and LitGPT. Controlled comparisons match observable inference budgets and separately test context scope at fixed runtime.
paper-1ad6e160560ae715.evidence: Claude Code–Codex–Claude Code reaches 62.5% HSTU execution accuracy versus 45.8% for the strongest matched-budget single-product baseline, a paired gain of 16.7 percentage points with a 95% interval of 6.6–26.7. LitGPT shows a 12.5-point gain. The deployment reports NDCG@10 of 0.2192 versus the published 0.2098 LARGE anchor, with its largest improvement coming from a metadata feature. Current-step prompting improves late-phase accuracy by 10.4 points at fixed runtime.
paper-1ad6e160560ae715.discovery_use: Contributes an explicitly evaluated harness for iterative ML research, combining hypothesis implementation, experiments, verification, retained findings, and coordination between coding-agent products.
paper-1ad6e160560ae715.limits: Evidence covers two Python/PyTorch repositories with incomplete oracles and black-box products. Observable budget matching cannot match hidden provider compute. Human steering and best-checkpoint selection limit attribution of deployment gains; cross-dataset results use single runs. Memory has no on/off ablation. The plan-merge flow’s apparent advantage requires extra budget and disappears under the matched cap; its uncapped paired contrast is statistically inconclusive. No genuine architectural novelty was demonstrated, and no first-party release was verified.

classification_review.rationale: Contributes an explicitly evaluated harness for iterative ML research, combining hypothesis implementation, experiments, verification, retained findings, and coordination between coding-agent products.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-2f1aa49aeba545c1.method: Fifteen attorneys author and review 413 questions. Thirteen models use web search, case-law search, document parsing, stored-content retrieval, and final submission under a three-hour cap. All-pass grading requires every rubric criterion and valid cited sources. GPT-5.4 judging is calibrated against attorneys, and no-tool single-shot runs provide an ablation.
paper-2f1aa49aeba545c1.evidence: The strongest tested model attains 42.9% all-pass despite 85.4% weighted pass. Reconciliation questions score 20.4% versus 29.9% without that attribute, with an adjusted penalty remaining after rubric and source-count controls. Removing tools lowers all-pass by 22.5 percentage points on average. More turns, calls, and cost do not reliably predict accuracy across models. Judge–expert task-level agreement is 86.7%.
paper-2f1aa49aeba545c1.discovery_use: Evaluates agents conducting open-ended investigations that require locating evidence, checking source validity, reconciling conflicting knowledge, and producing verified conclusions. This is a concrete discovery-evaluation contribution beyond static domain question answering.
paper-2f1aa49aeba545c1.limits: Restricted to objective U.S. English-language questions and a fixed model, tool, and authority snapshot. Only five questions and the harness are public; the remaining items are held out. Each model has one run per question, leaving run-to-run variance unmeasured. Model-mediated grading remains imperfect, and most adjacent leaderboard differences are not statistically distinguishable. The no-tool comparison also changes the interaction setting, so it is not a pure tool-only intervention.

classification_review.rationale: Evaluates agents conducting open-ended investigations that require locating evidence, checking source validity, reconciling conflicting knowledge, and producing verified conclusions. This is a concrete discovery-evaluation contribution beyond static domain question answering.

sections: Targeted method, evaluation and limitations passages
paper-74d382cf780e1dfd.method: Runs six agent configurations under three prompt packages, classifies intermediate discovery steps, and checks formulas against exact Berends–Giele recursion. Fixed-data symbolic-regression and ML comparisons assess approximate prediction separately. PI-and-student teams share findings while independently implementing checks; additional team structures address the previously unresolved six-point three-minus amplitude.
paper-74d382cf780e1dfd.evidence: Four of 18 single-agent runs recover the complete hydrotope formula, all with the true structural hint; none of six no-hint runs completes it. Both no-hint PI-plus-two-student runs succeed. Fitted comparison methods retain nonzero error under the tested settings. A new six-point three-minus expression passes 140 exact checks across 58 chambers. The observed bottleneck is combining local formulas and testing cases outside those used for construction.
paper-74d382cf780e1dfd.discovery_use: Directly studies scientific formula discovery through hypotheses, chosen numerical experiments, counterexamples, and independent verification. Its process analysis and new amplitude candidate provide a concrete discovery-capability contribution.
paper-74d382cf780e1dfd.limits: Prompt packages change both mathematical guidance and recommended tests. Configurations have only one run per condition; team comparisons are small and not compute matched, preventing causal attribution to coordination. The new-result experiment allows literature access and additional computation. Finite checks do not prove the new expression, and its arbitrary-wave-count extension remains open. Rewritten histories are author interpretations of visible records. The supplied PDF pages form a targeted review; primary-source HTML additionally supplied the omitted team-method and result sections, without exhaustive appendix or figure inspection.

classification_review.rationale: Directly studies scientific formula discovery through hypotheses, chosen numerical experiments, counterexamples, and independent verification. Its process analysis and new amplitude candidate provide a concrete discovery-capability contribution.

paper-98c6269e3dfb0ba6.method: Derives 12 structural questions per protein and jointly trains LoRA adapters through answer-token supervision and a frozen geometry decoder connected through a shared workspace. Evaluates three independently trained adapters on ten reasoning benchmarks, with shuffled-label, copying, random-geometry, component, model-family, and scaling comparisons. Protein-specific modules are removed for general reasoning evaluation.
paper-98c6269e3dfb0ba6.evidence: General-10 increases from 45.09% to 48.33%, with positive mean changes on all ten datasets; the nine public benchmarks gain 3.14 percentage points. Answer supervision accounts for most transfer: 2.93 points without geometry versus 3.23 for the full recipe. Transfer extends across Qwen scales and InternVL but is neutral for Gemma. Geometry primarily improves local structural readouts.
paper-98c6269e3dfb0ba6.discovery_use: Provides a concrete discovery-training contribution: converting scientific structures into automatically verified supervision and testing transfer to scientific, spatial, and graph reasoning.
paper-98c6269e3dfb0ba6.limits: The evidence establishes benchmark transfer, not autonomous discovery or an identified reasoning mechanism. Geometry's incremental aggregate benefit changes sign across seeds, global folding remains poor, and scaling increases data and optimization steps together. Remote-homology isolation and novel-fold generalization remain unverified. This was a targeted review of supplied body and selected appendix pages, not all 35 pages.

classification_review.rationale: Provides a concrete discovery-training contribution: converting scientific structures into automatically verified supervision and testing transfer to scientific, spatial, and graph reasoning.

paper-0c850351466e0ab2.method: An orchestrator evaluates structured executor outputs and appends search, refinement, or answer nodes. Executors receive summaries from direct dependencies and can retrieve transcript evidence. DAGRPO uses answer-ancestor membership to attenuate off-chain rewards and penalizes invalid plans. Evaluation covers three search benchmarks, multiple backbones, architecture ablations, efficiency measurements, and three RL training seeds.
paper-0c850351466e0ab2.evidence: At Qwen3-32B, DAGent scores 47.3%, 55.3%, and 65.0% on BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch. paper-0c850351466e0ab2.discovery_use: Directly advances research-agent investigation and verification through evidence-conditioned planning, uncertainty-triggered refinement, dependency-aware memory, and structural reinforcement learning.
paper-0c850351466e0ab2.limits: Benchmarks evaluate reference-answer search rather than open-ended scientific reports or experimentally established new knowledge. Graph ancestry is a contribution proxy, not causal attribution. Live retrieval and language-model judging affect results; human calibration uses 150 examples. RL covers one 8B backbone and 21 updates, and smaller component ablations use one seed. The verified code release still lists supporting training infrastructure as forthcoming.

classification_review.rationale: Directly advances research-agent investigation and verification through evidence-conditioned planning, uncertainty-triggered refinement, dependency-aware memory, and structural reinforcement learning.

paper-50a3bf2dcda6ba17.method: Ranks tokens using generator-classification gradient sensitivity minus detection sensitivity. A learned scorer selects tokens for generator-directed embedding perturbations. Alternating training combines clean and perturbed real/fake classification with prediction consistency. Evaluates eight baselines on 29 held-out entries, an 18-entry family-disjoint subset, matched controls, alternative backbones, corruptions, feature-space attacks, and codec normalization.
paper-50a3bf2dcda6ba17.evidence: Mean F1 reaches 92.62%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 5.31 points. The family-disjoint subset retains a 5.85-point lead. Random perturbation and global gradient reversal produce substantially smaller improvements. Generator-only token selection slightly underperforms the clean baseline. Results vary substantially by generator, and FORGE does not win every entry.
paper-50a3bf2dcda6ba17.discovery_use: Makes an explicit open-world recognition contribution by training detectors to generalize to unseen video generators and testing shortcut suppression under distribution shift.
paper-50a3bf2dcda6ba17.limits: This is fixed binary detection under unseen-source shifts, without discovering new semantic classes or adapting online. The broad split contains generator-family overlaps; the stricter split uses a name-and-lineage screen. Real videos share one source, leaving dataset confounds possible despite limited codec controls. Eight-frame evaluation does not establish long-video generalization, and white-box attacks still reduce F1 sharply. No first-party release was located in the bounded search; the paper promises release upon acceptance.

paper-476e87c36ff94c5c.method: Freezes forecasts before outcomes across 336 states in controlled learning, Tox21, and OpenML. Follow-up replays, component swaps, direct-note delivery, and known-information controls examine alternative explanations.
paper-476e87c36ff94c5c.evidence: Natural-explanation predictive credit remains unconfirmed. Tox21 cards reduce secondary repeat drift by 64.5%, but matched point accuracy does not reliably improve. OpenML cards widen intervals by approximately 21% without improved coverage; only 66 of 144 extracted cards contain content. paper-476e87c36ff94c5c.limits: Results depend on the forecaster, intervention distribution, loss, and donor resolution. Seed donors often share effect signs, limiting alignment discrimination. Extraction failures, only 12 endpoints and 24 external tasks, and concentrated task-scale effects constrain inference. Follow-up controls reuse known outcomes under separately frozen plans, and requested model routes lack resolved returned model IDs. Lean mechanization, Haskell differential testing, seeded ablations, and case studies evaluate the machinery.
paper-d66c8d011ed14fbb.evidence: The reported checker agrees with executable Lean semantics on 673 verdict-bearing and 66 malformed inputs. Removing checks admits incomplete support, missing conflicts, or unlicensed attacks. Formal results distinguish preserved support from preserved claim status: additional target-context objections can defeat transported support. Case studies demonstrate missing support, defeat, reinstatement, and assumption withdrawal.
paper-d66c8d011ed14fbb.discovery_use: Lara supplies a formal mechanism for research agents to check evidential support, expose missing obligations, revise conclusions under objections, and assess reuse across explicitly declared contexts.
paper-d66c8d011ed14fbb.limits: The checker trusts chosen policies, admitted evidence, and external assessment of prose-to-formal fidelity. It does not establish measurement accuracy or scientific truth. Three arguments remain on paper. Only deterministic lowering has been exercised end to end; autonomous formalization and bridge discovery are untested. The assembled corpus has pending human review and few recorded attacks. Finite conformance suites do not prove implementation equivalence. This is a targeted body and selected-appendix review; only the two supplied pages were visually inspected.

classification_review.rationale: Lara supplies a formal mechanism for research agents to check evidential support, expose missing obligations, revise conclusions under objections, and assess reuse across explicitly declared contexts.

paper-4fab9a768e49ef16.limits: Controlled distractors are composited observations with unchanged underlying task dynamics; queries primarily select objects by color. Persistent skill libraries are compared with empty-library runs and budget-matched best-of-three restarts. Frozen policies are graded separately on hidden states, usually across three independent repetitions. Additional studies transfer libraries between models, test self-exploration, and compare code policies with agent-trained VLAs.
paper-d8f686761184cfb8.evidence: Libraries help most when baseline competence is intermediate, but can preserve harmful mistakes. paper-d8f686761184cfb8.discovery_use: The main contribution evaluates whether autonomous agents acquire reusable knowledge from experience, separating retained learning from repeated attempts and measuring transfer beyond practiced situations.
paper-d8f686761184cfb8.limits: This is a targeted review of the supplied body and selected appendix pages, not all 49 pages. Simulation generally has only three repetitions; several VLA settings and physical practice conditions have one run. Model comparisons also change coding tools, and matched wall-clock budgets do not equalize all resources. Some privileged-information shortcuts survived isolation. Physical T5 results concern newly staged instances of tasks practiced on hardware, not demonstrated simulation-to-real skill transfer. Only skills and memories persist between tasks; broader joint evolution remains proposed. The official repository currently advertises forthcoming code.

classification_review.rationale: The main contribution evaluates whether autonomous agents acquire reusable knowledge from experience, separating retained learning from repeated attempts and measuring transfer beyond practiced situations.
